cert.removed: The local certificate is used again.
cert.title: Certificate
cert.trustAndroid: Android: open the downloaded file and install it as a CA certificate (Settings → Security → Encryption & credentials).
cert.trustDesktop: Windows/macOS/Linux: import the file as a trusted root certificate in the system or browser certificate store.
cert.trustIos: iPad/iPhone: open the file in Safari, install the profile under Settings → General → VPN & Device Management, then enable full trust under Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings.
cert.trustText: This server creates its own certificate authority (CA). Install the CA certificate once on every tablet and computer that opens the web interface – then the browser trusts the connection, even if the server’s IP address changes.
cert.trustTitle: Trust the server on tablets and browsers
cert.uploadText: Optional: use a certificate from your own CA, a purchased certificate or one issued by Tailscale. Players are not affected – they use a separate, pinned key.

schedules.groups.hint: Changes only the playlist of this group. “Don't change”: the group shows this rule's playlist for all screens or, if none is set, what other rules set.
schedules.groups.title: Playlist per display group
schedules.midnight.crosses: Crosses midnight: starts on the selected days at {start} and ends on the following day at {end}.
schedules.midnight.daysNote: The weekdays always refer to the day on which the window starts.
schedules.midnight.full_day: Start and end are equal: the window runs 24 hours, from {start} until {end} on the following day.
schedules.midnight.same_day: Runs on the selected days from {start} to {end}.
schedules.noDefault: No default rule: outside the windows the screens stay empty.
schedules.noZones: There are no zones yet. Create a zone first.

schedules.pricesOnlyOption: None – keep the running content (prices or ticker only)
schedules.priority.closed: The zone is CLOSED and has a playlist for CLOSED.
schedules.priority.default: The default rule of the zone.
schedules.priority.global: A global window that is active now.
schedules.priority.perItem: Each rule changes only what it contains: the playlist of all screens, the playlist of single display groups, prices or the ticker. For each of these, the first active rule in this order applies; everything else keeps running. Rules may overlap when they change different things.
schedules.priority.prices: Prices: zone window, then global window, then default rule, otherwise the base price. Rules whose playlist is not published are skipped.
schedules.priority.title: Which content runs? (priority)
schedules.priority.zone: A zone window that is active now.

schedules.problem.name: Enter a name.
schedules.problem.prices: Every price override needs a valid price.
schedules.scopeHint.default: Runs whenever no window is active. At most one per zone.
schedules.scopeHint.global: Runs in all zones during the window, unless a zone window is active.
schedules.scopeHint.zone: Runs in one zone during the window. Has priority over global windows.
schedules.subtitle: Weekly windows switch playlists, prices and tickers automatically. Screens evaluate them themselves, even without a server connection.
schedules.ticker.hideHint: Hides the ticker of other rules while this rule is active.
schedules.ticker.hint: Runs over the content of every screen of the zone while this rule is active – no ticker element needed in the presentation (e.g. Happy Hour). A slide with a ticker element set to “Ticker of the time schedule” shows the text there instead.
schedules.ticker.placeholder: e.g. Happy Hour until 7 pm – all cocktails €6
schedules.ticker.templateHint: Without a choice the zone’s ticker template is used.
schedules.ticker.templateHintGlobal: Without a choice every zone uses its own ticker template.
